_doc: Seconds each step of .github/workflows/pages.yml may take, keyed 'job/step name'. tools/step_budgets.py check-run fails the build job's last step on a step over its budget or with no row; tools/test_step_budgets.sh fails on a step with no row, and on a step that reads the whole corpus without naming the cache it restores ('cache'), how it limits itself to what changed ('incremental'), or why it can do neither ('uncached'). Raise a budget only with the reason in the commit: a budget that moves with every slowdown catches nothing.

build/Check out.note: was 120 with actions/checkout fetching the whole ~1GB tree every run (66s, run 38370347047). Now an incremental fetch on the cached store (tools/test_ci_checkout.sh); a cold store is the old full fetch

build/Draw the social cards.note: was 900: the card key hashed make_og_card.py's bytes, so any edit redrew all ~17k cards 600 a run (816s, run 38370347047). Now keyed on the card's rendered HTML: steady state is the cached list (~15-40s) plus the cards a push moved; worst case a code edit re-lists every row (~60s) and draws OG_LIMIT=120 cards at ~0.9s each

build/Generate the crawlable pages.note: a code or data change re-renders every puzzle page (tools/page_cache.py's fingerprint); a puzzle push re-renders the pages whose inputs moved

build/Stage the site.uncached: it links every generated page into _site and checks its links; already spread across the cores

build/Wait for the annotation check.note: zero unless validate is still running when the build is ready: only a full check (about four minutes) can outrun the build

build/Save the puzzle pages.note: runs only after a render of over 2000 pages (a code change, a cold cache)

validate/Choose what to check.note: a full check fetches the whole tree here, in four streams; the diff and the scope are a few seconds

validate/Check every annotation.uncached: the nightly and rule-change full check, spread across the runner's cores (validate_annotations.check_all); its budget is the alarm that it needs a bigger runner or a cache

validate/Trim the CodeQL caches.note: 16s for the first 204 deletions, by hand on 2026-10-13; a few a run after that

validate/Check the changed annotations.incremental: only the puzzle files changed since the last successfully deployed commit (Choose what to check)
